title: BrowserStartedData
description: data of browser.started (registry 1.7.0, ADR-0051, FR-CON-07): tilo-browser opened an isolated session for a unit and showed its first page. actor is the unit's agent, target the Browser Station building; authz null (browsing and reading are T1, BR-05). host is the start page's host; hosts counts the allowlist; frame is the first masked screenshot (an artifact of origin browser, BR-09), null when the page gave none. Never a full URL, query or page text (BR-13).
